name: prefire
description: Render SwiftUI #Preview as PNG images, so an AI agent sees the views it changes
long_description: Prefire renders the SwiftUI previews of an iOS or macOS project through its generated snapshot tests, on the devices, color schemes and text sizes asked for, and returns the images. Needs Xcode and a project set up for `prefire render`: see https://github.com/BarredEwe/Prefire/blob/main/Documentation/AI.md

config.title: Prefire config
config.description: The .prefire.yml of the project, with its render_configuration. Paths in it are read relative to its folder.

tools.name: list_previews
tools.description: List the previews of the project, with the file and line each is declared on

tools.name: render_previews
tools.description: Build the project and render previews as PNG images, on the devices, color scheme and text size asked for

tools.name: build_board
tools.description: Lay the last render out as an HTML board, grouped by user story
